name: theme
title: Theme
description: Ocean design tokens: the nine --ocean-* colours, control and panel radii, popup shadow, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge.
docs: Import the stylesheet once, in the same file that imports Tailwind. Light and dark follow color-scheme: the OS preference by default, or a .light or .dark class on the html element. There are no dark: variants, so overriding any --ocean-* value re-themes every component, including at runtime.
